title: Do the math: How we took over ChatGPT accounts
why_read: A concrete account takeover technique against ChatGPT accounts is directly relevant to engineers building or securing AI products.
analysis: This piece describes a real security exploit chain used to take over ChatGPT user accounts, likely involving token leakage, OAuth misconfiguration, or similar web-auth flaws. Because LLM products are now widely integrated into other services, understanding how such account-takeover vectors work has direct defensive value for engineers. The 'do the math' framing suggests a step-by-step technical narrative, which tends to be more substantive than abstract security punditry. This is the kind of vulnerability writeup that often yields concrete, reusable lessons about auth design.
